title: Althaea officinalis tea for medicinal use
intro: Althaea officinalis tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried leaves and flowers of the marshmallow plant. It is traditionally used in herbalism for its soothing and demulcent properties. This tea is often consumed to alleviate symptoms of respiratory conditions such as coughs and sore throats. It can also be used to ease digestive discomfort and promote overall comfort in the gastrointestinal tract. Its mild and calming effects make it a popular remedy for minor ailments and as a general tonic.
